generation.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: One new complete portrait poster for the Spidey Pokémon GO app, approximately 4:5 vertical, same high resolution and cinematic editorial finish as the approved reference. This is a NEW poster, not an edit of the reference.
Input images: Image 1 is the official Spidey brand logo; preserve its circular gold spider and turquoise eye design. Image 2 is a STYLE AND QUALITY reference only: match its rich atmosphere, premium gold typography, hierarchy, readable complete information and polished brand header. Do not reuse Thundurus, its text, shadow imagery or five-star raid symbols.
Primary request: Create the premium poster for the officially announced PASSE GO: OUTUBRO 2026 with NORMAL BLUE KYOGRE as the unmistakable central protagonist. This is the standard Kyogre, not Primal Kyogre, not a shiny, not a raid poster. Accurate Kyogre anatomy: gigantic elegant blue whale/orca-like Pokémon, smooth blue body, white underside, red geometric markings, broad flat pectoral fins with white fingernail-like tips, dorsal fin, and iconic forked tail. Dynamic three-quarter view sweeping through a spectacular ocean wave, body and face clearly visible.
Scene/backdrop: Grand cinematic ocean environment with crashing turquoise waves, underwater light shafts, submerged ancient ruins far in the background and luminous sea mist. Deep navy, cobalt and turquoise, warm gold premium trim. Rich depth and dramatic integrated light, no cutout on a generic background. Atmospheric architecture is decorative, not an event location.
Composition: Brand header occupies only upper 10%; Kyogre and its wave are dominant in upper/middle half. Lower part has a clean centered ornate gold title and a short date band, two polished reward ribbons and tiny source footer. Keep all text and source fully inside the poster with safe margins. Clear on a phone. No excessive text, no dashboard, no corporate slide.
Text (verbatim, Portuguese with all accents):
Brand: "Spidey" and "Pokémon GO", beside the official circular Spidey logo.
Main title: "PASSE GO"
Title below: "OUTUBRO"
Reward headline: "ENCONTRO COM KYOGRE"
Dates: "6 OUT — 3 NOV 2026"
Time line: "INÍCIO E FIM ÀS 10H • HORÁRIO LOCAL"
Separate Deluxe reward line: "DELUXE: GLOBO DA SORTE"
Bonus ribbon: "2× DURAÇÃO DO INCENSO DE AVENTURA DIÁRIO"
The bonus condition MUST be clearly printed directly underneath, not hidden: "AO ATINGIR O RANQUE 50".
Small footer: "Fonte: Pokémon GO • Anúncio oficial".
Factual constraints: Kyogre encounter is a GO Pass reward earned through progress, not a wild spawn or raid. Lucky Trinket belongs only to the paid Deluxe track; do not imply it is in the free pass. The incense duration bonus is unlocked at Rank 50, not active from the start. Dates and 10h local start/end must be exact. These details were checked in the primary announcement https://pokemongo.com/pt-BR/news/go-pass-october-2026. Do not add prices, shiny boost, remote trade distance, coordinates, raid stars, attacks, tickets, extra Pokémon, rewards or any unsupported claim.
Constraints: Create just one flat full poster image, no phone or browser mockup, no border around a screenshot. Strong vivid premium art matching the approved quality, visually distinct ocean theme. Exact Portuguese spelling. Preserve all reference files; only produce this new poster.
